# MovieBus <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Movies](BlitzBasic-Movies)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MovieBus:Void bus:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` (what movies start on) for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Picks the [audio bus](Audio-Buses) that the sound of movies opened after it plays on. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* [ChannelBus](ChannelBus) on [MovieChannel](MovieChannel) moves the sound of one movie that is open already.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
videos = CreateAudioBus()
MovieBus videos
intro = OpenMovie("intro.mp4")
AudioBusVolume videos, 0.8
```
